title: GET /chat/threads/{id}/turns data (lld.md#chat)
description: Up to 50 saved turns, oldest first, in the order the Worker stored them. `hasMore` says earlier turns exist; then `nextBefore` is the ID of this page's oldest turn and is what the next request sends as `before`, so a client never derives a paging anchor from its own clock or its own record. `nextBefore` is null exactly when `hasMore` is false. Each turn is the same shape as a single turn read and is judged against current privacy on every read, so a later page cannot bring back an answer that no longer holds.
